title: Parafermionic observable vertex relation at x_c and σ=5/8
statement_scope: At x=x_c and σ=5/8, the parafermionic observable F satisfies, for every vertex v∈V(Ω), the complex relation (p−v)F(p)+(q−v)F(q)+(r−v)F(r)=0, where p,q,r are the mid-edges of the three edges adjacent to v; Ω is a simply connected hexagonal-lattice domain and F is the observable from Definition 1.

standard_prerequisites: Hexagonal lattice H, its mid-edges, and the three mid-edges p,q,r adjacent to a vertex v.
Simply connected domain Ω⊂H, self-avoiding walks γ⊂Ω from a boundary mid-edge a, and their winding W_γ(a,z).
Parafermionic observable F(z)=F(a,z,x,σ)=Σ_{γ:a→z} e^{-iσ W_γ(a,z)} x^{ℓ(γ)}.
Complex arithmetic and the identities λ=e^{-i5π/24} and x_c^{-1}=√(2+√2)=2cos(π/8).
Opposite orientation of a self-avoiding loop and the two one-step extensions from a mid-edge to the other adjacent mid-edges.
